description: This file defines the 'AuthParams' class within the OrangeHRM authentication module. It implements an interface and manages authentication-related data, specifically user credentials and attribute bags, providing getter methods that return clones of its private properties.

classes.name: AuthParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) that encapsulates authentication parameters, including user credentials and attribute bags.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an instance of AuthParams with optional user credential and attribute bag interfaces.

methods.name: getCredential
methods.description: Returns a clone of the stored user credential interface.

methods.name: getAttributeBag
methods.description: Returns a clone of the stored attribute bag interface.
